image_description: A low-angle, slightly chaotic outdoor shot of a maypole celebration. A tall pole (partially obscured by ribbons) is the central vertical element, adorned with numerous long, colorful ribbons (red, green, yellow, blue) extending downwards. A crowd of people, including children and adults, surrounds the base, holding or standing near the ribbons. The background features a building with scaffolding on the left and a white structure on the right. The lighting suggests daytime.

artifact_observations.location: Upper left quadrant, ribbon attachment point
artifact_observations.reasoning: The ribbons do not attach to a single coherent central pole. Instead, they seem to emerge from a chaotic, undefined mass or multiple disjointed points near the scaffolding. The geometry of the pole top is nonsensical and lacks structural integrity.
The red and green ribbons appear to melt into or pass through the metal scaffolding bars in the background without proper occlusion or physical interaction logic.
Faces in the lower foreground exhibit slight smearing and lack of distinct features typical of AI generation when rendering crowds. Hands holding ribbons are indistinct or missing fingers.
The vertical lines of the scaffolding and building on the left show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence.
